An actor alleges reassignment of a material classification under an exact versioned scheme and procedure, retaining before/after class and traceability claim basis. A label change does not silently create, transform or continue a cohort.

An actor alleges removal of a specified material extent from its declared use/inventory route by the named disposal procedure and destination. Disposal is not movement, reclassification, or a successor-producing transformation.

subjectKindDecision.rationale: Accepted identity law and event grammar require equipment/tool, storage-place and container meanings; OFARM2 Core has an equipment payload. None is aliased to INPUT, FACILITY or OPERATION.
subjectKindDecision.typedEndpointRule: The claim subject and any such context endpoint carry their exact new kind and immutable identity binding. Equipment participation remains a separate role even when another object is the claim subject. A storage location is related to a FACILITY; it is not the facility. A CONTAINER is not its LOT occupant.
subjectKindDecision.anchorRule: Keep the existing sole authority-anchor kinds and exact source extraction. An EQUIPMENT/TOOL/STORAGE_LOCATION/CONTAINER subject needs actual admitted relation to a valid FARM/SITE/FACILITY or other already admitted anchor. No new authority anchor, authorization action or implicit permission is introduced.
proposedFiles: future domain contract and payload/trace schemas: typed subject/context and evidence predicates
subjectKindDecision.dependentWork: Existing identity and relationship owners must provide exact typed resolution/proof interfaces; mechanical input/body repins follow in separate owner work. No identity is created or revised by this inventory or by a pending assertion. Physical identity registry writes/authority remain their own trust boundary.
subjectKindDecision.equipmentVersusTool: Use EQUIPMENT for an equipment asset, TOOL for a tool asset. Their common durable-asset continuity rule is shared; type is not silently inferred from an ID prefix.
